speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Our Public Service must rise to the challenges of heightened global uncertainties, rising public expectations, and tightening resource constraints in manpower, fiscal, land and carbon.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: The Public Service will continue to deliver sustainable, efficient and effective solutions.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: This approach will accelerate the cross-pollination of ideas and develop impactful solutions to address Singapore’s needs and opportunities.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will enhance WOG digital learning and career planning platforms for officers.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: While our values remain constant, our approach to service delivery will continue to evolve.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will deliver not just for Singaporeans, but with Singaporeans.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will serve with conviction and purpose to build a Singapore that all of us are proud to call home.
